1//! The null object.
2
3use crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::Object;
4use crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::macros::object;
5use crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::reader::Reader;
6use crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::reader::{Readable, ReaderContext, Skippable};
7
8/// The null object.
9#[derive(Debug, Eq, PartialEq, Clone, Copy, Hash)]
10pub struct Null;
11
12object!(Null, Null);
13
14impl Skippable for Null {
15    fn skip(r: &mut Reader<'_>, _: bool) -> Option<()> {
16        r.forward_tag(b"null")
17    }
18}
19
20impl Readable<'_> for Null {
21    fn read(r: &mut Reader<'_>, ctx: &ReaderContext<'_>) -> Option<Self> {
22        Self::skip(r, ctx.in_content_stream())?;
23
24        Some(Self)
25    }
26}
